agent_notes: Government directory verification succeeded: the supplied NIRF 2025 Open University listing contains the exact institution name, Prayagraj (Allahabad), and Uttar Pradesh.
The official homepage confirms the Prayagraj campus and institutional identity; no similarly named college or alternate campus was used.

Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error. Public GET requests to confirmed official/search hostnames used curl --insecure only after hostname confirmation.

The official catalogue is distributed across school pages and a 2026-27 brochure. Several programme-category links are blank or non-specific, and the brochure does not fully reconcile every school-listed programme; therefore the catalogue is partial and the record requires manual review.
Only degree, diploma, certificate, and doctoral programmes were imported. Awareness and non-credit awareness programmes were excluded from the course array.
Durations and eligibility were retained only where explicitly stated by an official catalogue page or the central official brochure; no specializations were invented.

Career mappings were checked against read-only assets/data/career_path.db. Direct discipline nodes were preferred; nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings use lower confidence where the local tree has no exact discipline node.
